posts.title: Homebrew Website Club - Philadelphia
posts.description: Homebrew Website Clubs are online and/or in-person meetups where we discuss designing and developing our personal websites as a way to take back our online identities and control our content. This is an in-person-only event. Join us at Iffy Books in Philadelphia for our fourteenth Philly Homebrew Website Club! Common discussion topics include: Website design and development with HTML and CSS Progr
